title: Price of the Shackles
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was lost in the shock of his new ability, a sharp pain suddenly pierced his chest—that was the resonance between Chen Nian and the Heavenly Fate Lock Key. The countdown to March seventh seemed to draw yet another moment closer.

text.content:
Ye Qing's words were like a soft blade, seemingly harmless, yet they pierced directly into the softest part of Chen Ji's heart. Beyond the chessboard—these four words he had never dared to think. Mo Xiansheng had said that the Tianji Record itself was a piece of Heaven's chess game, so what right did he have to step out of this game?

The candlelight wavered, stretching and shortening their two shadows alternately. Chen Ji didn't answer immediately; instead, he slowly raised his head, and in those usually murky eyes, a hint of an edge never shown to others flashed past.

dialogue.content: The demonic mist swirled slowly around Ye Qing as her voice dropped even lower: "Yes, gamble. Gamble that you can become the Chess Player, not a piece. The Prophet's inheritance from the Holy Sect—I obtained part of it."

text.content:
Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. The Prophet's inheritance—that was the core will crystal left behind by each successive Tianji Record holder after death. Mo Xiansheng had said that those who wished to obtain the inheritance must endure all of their predecessor's memories and karmic debts, with costs so severe that even great powers dared not attempt it lightly.

And yet Ye Qing was actually offering such a supreme treasure freely?

dialogue.content: "I want you to take me to meet someone." A flicker of vulnerability never seen before crossed Ye Qing's deep eyes. "Meet that person... who was also used as a piece."

text.content:
The moment her voice fell, a blinding golden light suddenly illuminated the secret chamber. The jade pendant at Chen Ji's chest trembled violently, as if sensing something. That was—the Tianji Record itself resonating.

Within the golden light, a illusory figure slowly coalesced—the remnant will left by the successive Prophets, drawing near to its true master.

choice.prompt: The remnant will in the golden light is calling out, and the fourth page of the Tianji Record faintly appears. Facing this rare opportunity, how should Chen Ji choose?

choices.description: Endure the pain of memories flooding in, gamble to obtain stronger foresight ability.
choices.visible_cost: Endure the karmic backlash, shackles deepen
choices.visible_reward: The fourth page of the Tianji Record manifests, foresight range expands
choices.risk_hint: The pain of memories flooding in could drive one insane

text.content:
The golden light suddenly engulfed Chen Ji. In that moment, he felt himself being torn apart and reorganized by countless consciousnesses—the memories of each Prophet at the moment of their death surged into his Mental Sea like a tide.

Pain.

That kind of pain was not physical, but the despair of a soul being repeatedly crushed.

But Chen Ji did not retreat. He clenched his teeth tightly, desperately searching for his own thread of clarity within the torrent of memories.

Who knows how long passed—perhaps three breaths, perhaps three years—when he opened his eyes again, the fourth page of the Tianji Record had completely unfolded in his mind.

choices.memory_label: 接受了夜清的预言者传承

choices.description: Before making a decision, demand that Ye Qing first explain all the costs clearly.
choices.risk_hint: The timing of the inheritance may pass in an instant

text.content:
Chen Ji did not act rashly; instead, he calmly looked at Ye Qing: "How much do you actually know about the price of this inheritance?"

Ye Qing was slightly stunned, clearly not expecting him to be so cautious. But it was precisely this prudence that earned him a new level of genuine respect in her eyes.

However, the moment the fourth page completely unfolded, Chen Ji's expression changed drastically.

What appeared on that page was not a vision of the future, but a long-sealed memory—a memory about Chen Nian.

In the memory, Chen Nian was surrounded by Holy Sect experts, but she was not there as a captive—she was there as the core.

That mysterious altar constructed from countless rune formations, Chen Nian stood right at its center. There was a golden mark between her brows, identical to the runes on the Tianji Record.

The true vessel of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key was never Chen Ji himself.

But his sister who had been missing for years.

dialogue.content: "You've finally discovered it." The remnant soul of Mo Xiansheng sighed softly. "When the Tianji Record chose you back then, it was because of the blood connection between you and Chen Nian. Only through you could it sense the existence of the Lock Key. And now..."
"And now, every time I use the Tianji Record, I am drawing from her Heavenly Fate." Chen Ji's voice was cold as ice. "Right?"

text.content:
In the Mental Sea, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul remained silent for a moment before finally speaking: "Not entirely. The Heavenly Fate Value you consume does indeed come from Chen Nian—but it's not absorption, it's... resonance. You were originally one being split into two; the Tianji Record merely made you the dominant vessel, while she became the hidden core."

Chen Ji's hands slowly clenched into fists, his knuckles whitening from the force.

choice.prompt: After learning the truth, how should Chen Ji face this cruel discovery?

choices.description: Immediately stop the inheritance to avoid continuing to consume Chen Nian's Heavenly Fate.
choices.visible_cost: Lose part of the inheritance's benefits, shackle backlash intensifies
choices.visible_reward: Temporarily protect Chen Nian, preserve room for subsequent action
choices.risk_hint: Forcefully interrupting may harm one's own soul

text.content:
Chen Ji violently severed his connection to the inheritance. Within his Mental Sea, golden light scattered, and the fourth page that was about to fully unfold was forcibly suppressed.

The violent backlash caused blood to seep from his seven orifices, but he didn't even frown.

"I'd rather never use this damned book again than gamble with Niannian's life."

choices.memory_label: 为保护陈念强行中断传承

choices.description: Since we've already come this far, we must obtain complete foresight ability.
choices.visible_cost: Continuously consume Chen Nian's Heavenly Fate, may accelerate her crisis
choices.visible_reward: Obtain complete fourth page abilities, foresight range greatly improved
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian's situation may deteriorate as a result

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the surging rage within him.

"I need to see more." He said quietly. "Only by knowing the complete truth can I save her."

Golden light surged again; this time, Chen Ji actively embraced the torrent of memories, actively enduring every ounce of pain.

choices.memory_label: 为救陈念承受完整传承

text.content:
The moment Chen Ji made his choice, the abilities of the fourth page fully unfolded.

It was no longer the vague three-hour foresight, but a terrifyingly clear vision—the seventh day of March, at the altar where Chen Nian was located, experts from the three Demonic Path sects and the Holy Sect had gathered, all watching her greedily, fixated on the golden mark between her brows.

And beneath that altar, a presence Chen Ji knew all too well lurked quietly.

It was Ling Yuan.

dialogue.content: "Old Sect Master... so he was the final mantis stalking the cicada." Mo Xiansheng's voice rarely carried a hint of solemnity. "Chen Ji, do you understand now? You were never a match for Ling Yuan—from the very beginning, he was using you to approach the Tianji Record, using you to activate the Lock Key within Chen Nian."

text.content:
Chen Ji said nothing. He simply stood there quietly, letting blood trickle from the corner of his eye, yet a cold smile curved his lips.

Fine.

Very well.

Ling Yuan, after这么多年的棋局 now, it's time for me to make my move.

dialogue.content: "Ye Qing." He suddenly spoke, his voice terrifyingly calm. "On that seventh day of March, at the Holy Sect headquarters—I need you to help me with something."

Ye Qing slightly raised an eyebrow: "What is it?"

"Let Ling Yuan know that I, Chen Ji, personally want to send him to his death." In those usually murky eyes, flames that could burn through everything now blazed.

choice.prompt: Facing the upcoming showdown on March seventh, how should Chen Ji plan his moves?

choices.description: Personally go to the altar for a direct confrontation with Ling Yuan, don't let anyone else get involved.
choices.visible_cost: No backup, face multiple great powers alone
choices.visible_reward: Disrupt the enemy's plans, catch Ling Yuan off guard
choices.risk_hint: May fall into encirclement, life or death uncertain

text.content: Ye Qing was silent for a moment, then slowly nodded: "I'll provide support from the outside. But remember—" her voice rarely became serious, "You're not alone."

choices.description: Unite with Ye Qing, Han Lie and others to jointly oppose Ling Yuan.
choices.visible_cost: Need to reveal some trump cards, may trigger chain reactions
choices.visible_reward: Obtain powerful allies, greatly improve odds of victory
choices.risk_hint: There may be insiders among the allies

text.content:
"Since we're playing chess, we must use all the pieces." A cold smile curved Chen Ji's lips. "Ling Yuan thinks he has calculated everything, but he doesn't know—the true chess player never plays just one game."

The fourth page of the Tianji Record slowly rotated in his mind; his foresight ability had improved by more than tenfold. On March seventh, he would make Ling Yuan understand what it meant to miscalculate.

choices.memory_label: 决定联络盟友共同作战

text.content:
Outside the secret chamber, the night wind was like a blade.

Chen Ji stood before the window, gazing toward the distant Tianqing Sect. That place which once required him to tread carefully now lay transparent before his eyes. Every move Ling Yuan made, he could see clearly.

But—he looked down at his own hands, where faint golden patterns faintly emerged, like invisible shackles winding beneath the skin.

The price of the inheritance was not merely the consumption of Heavenly Fate Value. The karmic debts left by the successive Prophets were gradually eroding his soul.

He could feel himself merging with the Tianji Record.

Or rather—becoming the next Mo Xiansheng.

dialogue.content: "Niannian..." Chen Ji murmured to himself, his voice carrying a warmth never shown before. "Wait for me. This time, it's big brother's turn to save you."

text.content:
The moment his voice fell, a sharp pain stabbed his chest.

That was the resonance between Chen Nian and the Heavenly Fate Lock Key—stronger than any time before.

Chen Ji clutched his chest tightly, sweat beading on his forehead. The fourth page of the Tianji Record automatically unfolded, revealing a blurry image: Chen Nian lying within some formation, surrounded by dense runes, and the mark between her brows was fading little by little.

March seventh.

The countdown was closer than he had imagined.
